accepted.sentence: On sandy beaches, extra-wide, low-pressure tires help riders cross soft ground with less risk of sinking.
During time trials, riders adopt aerodynamic positions and use specialized handlebars to reduce wind resistance.
On grass courts, players wield long mallets while steering and maneuvering around opponents during matches.
At community repair workshops, volunteers teach owners to adjust gear shifting and replace worn brake cables.
Along remote backcountry routes, frame-mounted bottle cages help touring riders carry water between refill points.
In school safety courses, children practice scanning for traffic and signaling before navigating ordinary streets.
In crowded pedestrian zones, local rules may require riders to walk their machines through the busiest sections.
At timed endurance events, support crews may provide food and water at designated roadside checkpoints.
